name: Judge William Smith
bioAdditions: Of Mastic, of the 'Tangier' Smith family (not a Bull Smith). Pelletreau (S1) says he married Mary, daughter of Daniel Smith 2d and Hannah Brewster, that his sister Martha married Caleb Smith of Hauppauge, that Gen. John Smith (U.S. Senator) was 'the son of Judge William and Mary Smith', and that he 'suffered greatly from the British occupation of Long Island'. In-law.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 476, 491
